title: Optimally Selling Heterogeneous Objects by Quantity
abstract: arXiv:2610.36244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study the optimality of selling K heterogeneous objects to a buyer with private values through a quantity menu: the seller posts a price for each number of objects, and the buyer chooses a quantity, pays its price, and selects any objects up to that quantity. I propose a pricing method that aggregates critical values for second differences of quantity values (the highest values attainable at each quantity). Critical values can be determined separately when each second difference's conditional inverse-hazard ratio depends only on that difference. For additive values, I show that the resulting menu is optimal among all incentive-compatible and individually rational mechanisms under explicit distributional and support conditions, including ex ante symmetry across object labels. translated_title: 按数量最优出售异质物品
translated_abstract: 我研究通过数量菜单向拥有私人估值的买方出售K件异质物品的最优性问题：卖方为每种数量公布一个价格，买方选择数量、支付相应价格，并可从中任选不超过该数量的任意物品。我提出了一种定价方法，将数量估值的二阶差分的临界值（即各数量上可实现的最高估值）聚合起来。当每个二阶差分的条件逆风险率仅依赖于该差分本身时，各临界值可以分别确定。对于可加估值，我证明在明确的分布与支撑集条件（包括物品标签间的事前对称性）下，所得的价格菜单在所有激励相容且个体理性的机制中是最优的。另一项独立结果将同样的定价方法应用于非可加的捆绑估值情形，在假设自由处置与（相互）独立性、且无需事前对称性的条件下，得到了最优的价格菜单。
tldr: 本文提出一种聚合数量估值二阶差分临界值的定价方法，证明了在可加估值及非可加捆绑估值等条件下，数量菜单是向私人估值买方出售异质物品的最优机制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a pricing method that aggregates critical values of second differences of quantity values and proves that a quantity menu is optimal among all incentive-compatible and individually rational mechanisms for selling heterogeneous objects, for both additive values and nonadditive bundle values.
